name: Alfacar (Spain)
description: Green field with a white bend from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Alfacar (a tower, a bread oven and a spring).
history: Alfacar adopted its arms and flag officially on 4 August 2006; the flag is rectangular of 2:3, a green cloth with a white bend from the upper hoist corner to the lower fly of 1/6 of the length of the flag, with the municipal arms over all at the centre.

features.role: bend from the upper hoist to the lower fly, 1/6 of the length
Alfacar arms — tower, bread oven and spring
